dataclass Alias
  host: str
  name: str
  resident: bool
  servable: bool
  hosted: bool
  profiles: list[str]
dataclass Ask
  at: str
  caller: str
  user: str
  model: str
  family: str
  verdict: str
  host: str
const CREDENTIAL_CONSUMERS
dataclass Caller
  user_description: str
  path_description: str
dataclass Decision
  asked: str
  family: str
  verdict: str
  host: str
  model: str
  endpoint: str
  installed_on: list[str]
  authorised: HostAllowance | None
  withheld: list[str]
  loads: int
  why: str
class DispatchError(ValueError)
  __init__(code)
dataclass Family
  family: str
  names: list[Alias]
dataclass HostAllowance
  hosts: list[str]
dataclass HostState
  host: str
  base: str
  up: bool
  why: str
  installed: int
  resident: list[str]
  servable: bool
  hosted: bool
  wire: str
  credential: str
  declared_by: str
  profiles: list[str]
  domain: str
dataclass HostsSnapshot
  observation: Observation
  hosts: list[HostState]
  doubled: list[str]
  asked: list[Ask]
dataclass ModelsSnapshot
  observation: Observation
  models: list[Family]
dataclass Observation
  caller: Caller
  took_ms: int
  cache_age_ms: int
const PROFILES
dataclass PickRequest
  model: str
  fresh: bool
  allowed: HostAllowance | None
  profile: str
dataclass PickResult
  observation: Observation
  decision: Decision
const ROUTER_ERROR_CODES
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
class Router
  models(fresh: bool) -> ModelsSnapshot
  hosts(fresh: bool) -> HostsSnapshot
  pick(request: PickRequest) -> PickResult
class RouterClient(Router)
  __init__(transport)
  models(fresh: bool) -> ModelsSnapshot
  hosts(fresh: bool) -> HostsSnapshot
  pick(request: PickRequest) -> PickResult
class ServiceError(Exception)
  __init__(code, message)
enum ServiceErrorCode
  HANDLER_ERROR = 'handler_error'
  INVALID_RESULT = 'invalid_result'
  UNKNOWN_VERSION = 'unknown_version'
  UNKNOWN_SERVICE = 'unknown_service'
  UNKNOWN_METHOD = 'unknown_method'
  WRONG_MODE = 'wrong_mode'
  INTERNAL = 'internal'
  INVALID_REQUEST = 'invalid_request'
  CALLER_REFUSED = 'caller_refused'
  UNKNOWN_OPERATION = 'unknown_operation'
  POLICY_UNAVAILABLE = 'policy_unavailable'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
